workspace.chrome: Compact System, Procedures, Execution, Help menu and connection status
workspace.navigation: Left procedure catalog; Enter or double-click opens the selected procedure
workspace.utilities: Left Outline, Variables and Call stack tabs
workspace.main: Permanent Master tab and separately selected procedure-instance tabs
workspace.presentation: Tabular numbered highlighted source with Code, Data and Result columns; Text, As-run and Support log views
workspace.control: Controller ownership, revision and connection checks retained; command toolbar, bounded keyboard command field and prompt below source
workspace.secondary: Collapsible execution-data dock and separate Driver foundation, Data services and Development workspaces

data_rules: Data and Result require an explicit line-correlated event for the selected execution
Executed-line coverage alone never implies a successful result
Source is rendered as escaped text and is never evaluated in the browser
Outline navigation is interlocked while the procedure is running
Switching instance tabs cannot expose another instance's control panel while its snapshot loads
browser_dispositions: Automatic loopback simulator connection replaces the manual listener/context dialog by owner request
Narrow screens stack navigation and procedure panes and scroll the source table horizontally
Browser tabs replace native Eclipse detached windows; no native window or docking parity is claimed
Call stack shows committed parent/current/child procedure relationships, not an arbitrary Python frame inspector
Typed inspection retains audited edits; unrestricted Python Shell and arbitrary expression evaluation remain excluded
No real GCS, spacecraft, host memory, domain-family or commanding indicators are fabricated
